messages:
raj-platform: FYI sales pushed a request from ACME to short‑term bypass tenant routing and route their org-id directly to the 'gpu-premium' pool for a big demo tomorrow.
mike-sre: Oof. Do we have an existing escape-hatch flow for that? what about quotas & sticky route TTLs?
raj-platform: We do but it's usually gated. Proposal: add a per-org allowlist entry with explicit TTL=48h, audit entry, and auto-expire. Need quick approval from SRE + ProdEng + Legal.
carla-prodeng: Condition: the override must not skip quota checks or cost accounting. It can pin route but still charge against their account and emit full traces. Otherwise ops loses visibility.
amanda-ux: Console ask: wherever this is created, show (1) who requested, (2) approver, (3) expiry timestamp, (4) temporary banner on routes dashboard. Quick mock attached — will post after this thread. :thumbsup:
lina-legal: Need to confirm data residency implications — if gpu-premium is in a different region we may need a signed AOR from ACME. Also record of approval is required for audit.
raj-platform: Agreed on audit. My draft implementation (routing DSL tweak):
```json
{
  "org_id": "acme-123",
  "override": {
    "route": "gpu-premium",
    "ttl_secs": 172800,
    "bypass_quota": false,
    "created_by": "raj-platform",
    "reason": "sales demo",
    "audit_ticket": "",
    "approved_by": ""
  }
}
```
carla-prodeng: That looks OK. Enforceable checks we need: denylist precedence, header-based sticky routing should still be evaluated before a manual allowlist? or vice-versa? We must decide precedence rules.
mike-sre: My vote: explicit manual allowlist should win only if it includes a flag allow_insecure=false. Otherwise keep header-affinity first so customers using org-header stay consistent. For ACME demo we can set allow_insecure=true but then add telemetry spike alerts.
raj-platform: Good point. For this instance we can set allow_insecure=true but require "monitoring_alert": "route_mismatch_spike". Also add a rollout canary: 5% traffic first.
deploy-bot: new-ticket created: RP-4821, workflow: per-org-override-temp; reviewers: mike-sre, carla-prodeng, lina-legal.
amanda-ux: UI note: show an inline "safety checklist" before approve: quota checked, residency ok, audit ticket linked. If any item fails, show red state + block approve.
lina-legal: I'll sign off once ACME confirms region consent in email thread. Put the email link in the audit_ticket field.
mike-sre: I'll stand up the alert and add tracing tags: route_override=manual, override_ttl=172800, approver=mike-sre when approved.
raj-platform: Thanks — will add canary config and update the console flow. If we get final OK I'll approve in the ticket and push the rule (will post applied rule snippet here). :eyes:
carla-prodeng: One more: add a webhook to append an immutable record to the org's audit log store (s3) when override created/expired.
raj-platform: +1. plan: create the allowlist entry, set ttl, link ticket RP-4821, canary 5%, enable alerting, push to prod after approvals.
mike-sre: SGTM. If any unexpected latency/cost spike we roll back the allowlist immediately. :warning:
deploy-bot: RP-4821 status -> awaiting final approval from lina-legal.
lina-legal: Approved — ACME consent on file. Approving override for 48h. lina-legal approved at 1738457042.
